title: Changing my life and healing my nervous system
body:
F, late-diagnosed freelancer and artist - I use both the app and the coaching program. It’s been about 5 months now and I can already see such a positive difference in my life. I’m planning to be in this community for the long haul. Nothing compares out there. It’s built with real research behind it and it shows in every way you interact with it. 

I have a ways to go in terms of learning about ADHD and also healing my nervous system from a lifetime of not knowing why I felt so different. I’m his tool is helping me do that at my own pace. 

The tool and learning modules are self paced, informative, and positive. I really love when I have time to sit and learn. Theres also a great library of recorded content, so I get to enjoy the many virtual workshops and masterclasses whenever my schedule allows. 

The daily body doubling sessions are a game changer for getting things done! 

My 1:1 coaching sessions are life changing. I’m not exaggerating. These coaches are the real deal. They are so knowledgeable. I feel like I’m being provided with supportive accountability and mentorship without feeding the shame loop we tend to fall into. Both of the coaches Ive been paired with have been perfect. They really take the time to match you with the right people. 

I tell everyone I know who is neurodivergent about Shimmer. I’m so grateful to the developers and team for bringing this amazing resource to us at such an accessible price. You’re making a positive difference in many lives.

title: Exceptionally Well Designed and Helpful
body:
Shimmer has improved my life a LOT!   Even just the software is somehow (it’s spooky) getting me to exercise daily, stick to my diet, get out of my home early, and actually do my highest priority tasks. 

The software also supports Shimmers excellent one-on-one coaching, which is highly motivating.  AI processing is offered as *option* to summarize the confidential conversations.  These summaries are excellent. 

Overall the Shimmer app is very well designed and implemented.   Many thoughtful and clever details support me to focus and be happy / productive despite ADHD style procrastination problems. 

Definitely check out Shimmer if you would like (or *need*) support with getting things done in your life.

As someone with muddled thinking (recently realized I’ve had adhd all along but thought I was just chaotic or “bad” at follow-through), the app makes the things I want to do so much clearer, like I have a friend guiding me along and cheering my wins. The cost is a stretch, but more affordable than working with an adhd coach, and offers SO much more with daily body doubling sessions, learning modules, and a way to define your goals and life plan out in a way that has shifted my fundamental understanding of myself and my ability to make my dreams a reality. title: A Game-changer for managing ADHD
body: After six months of using Shimmer, I can confidently say it's been transformative, especially with tasks that previously felt insurmountable. Before Shimmer, simple errands like scheduling appointments felt like monumental tasks, often taking me years to accomplish. The app, with its personalized coaching, has been a breakthrough in tackling my ADHD-related challenges.What sets Shimmer apart is the truly personalized care. My coach has been instrumental in helping me understand the roots of my difficulties and devising unique strategies tailored just for me. For instance, to enhance my nightly self-care routine with my Gua Sha—a simple self-care tool used for facial massage—they suggested keeping it in an insulated cup to maintain its coolness and using cleaning wipes for convenience. This simple yet effective advice has made a significant difference in my commitment to self-care.Moreover, Shimmer validated my approach to overcoming video game addiction. Unlike the well-meaning advice from friends, my coach supported my "cold turkey" strategy from an ADHD perspective, helping me understand why gradual reduction methods don't suit my self-regulation struggles. This understanding and validation empowered me to quit gaming for extended periods, freeing up my time for personal growth, supporting my partner's business, reconnecting with friends, and increasing my physical activity.In essence, Shimmer isn't just an app; it's a partner in navigating the complexities of ADHD. It's about understanding yourself better and unlocking your potential through strategies that work for you. If you're looking for a supportive, personalized approach to managing ADHD, Shimmer might just be the game-changer you need.

title: So far, so good!
body:
I have been doing ADHD coaching for about 1 month and so far it’s been a good experience. 

A major perk is that you can use HSA funds to pay for coaching. The cost is also very affordable compared to other ADHD coaching providers, so I sincerely hope that the staff is also being compensated fairly given the low cost.

I like that my coach Staci lets the conversation be whatever I want it to be. Some days I need help with specific tasks, or we set aside the time as a “working session” where I can actually do the tasks I have been putting off as I struggle heavily with procrastination. 

Staci also brings a lot of recommendations from her other clients that have helped them manage their ADHD, so the knowledge sharing element alone is invaluable.

 I have already recommended Shimmer to a handful of my ADHD friends because it normalizes the ADHD struggle and motivates me and holds me accountable before each weekly session.

author: MH60Mom

title: Everyone with ADHD should try Shimmer
body:
Since my ADHD diagnosis at the age of 38, and even before, I have tried probably close to 100 apps looking for the right one to help me manage my ADHD. The one that clicked and made me feel like it would actually make a real difference for me. Most of them either overwhelmed or underwhelmed me. Some of them were cost prohibitive. Then I stumbled upon Shimmer. A few things about it stood out to me right away before I even signed up. 

First of all, I am able to use my HSA account to pay for it. That gave me confidence that it must be legit, and also helped me sustainably build it into my budget. Second, there was no “free trial” or free vs paid version - which I have learned the hard way is often a trap. Third - the cost is actually affordable. I was getting ready to sign up for an ADHD/life coach that is local to me, and the cost was going to be $500/month. 

I wanted to wait a full month before posting this review, because 99% of the time I will be obsessed with something at first and then quickly lose interest. That has not been the case with Shimmer. I know this is going to be part of my life for the foreseeable future. It is actually making a difference for me!!! 

The app is so easy to use and appealing without being overwhelming. It has just the right balance of guidance and freedom. You can set and track your goals, text with your coach (more on that), and access learning modules that you can work on at your own pace. Throughout all of the features, there’s an underlying element of reflection, which has been a game changer for me! 

Now for the best part - you are working with actual people! I have a weekly video session with my coach. She is absolutely amazing!! She has helped me understand how my ADHD is impacting my life in ways I never realized, and more importantly, how to make small tweaks in my life that lead to big improvements. I always leave our sessions feeling focused and motivated. She checks in on me between sessions and I feel like I can always reach out to her as well. 

Finally, the founders of Shimmer and the admins REALLY CARE! They want to create something that is actually helping people. They have personally reached out to ask how I’m doing, and for any feedback and suggestions. They listen to members and are always trying to evolve Shimmer. The great news is, it’s already amazing!!
